name: Buck Naked
source:
Cliff the raccoon sees naked deer wherever he goes. That's...not out of the ordinary for him, and that's the way he likes it. But an odd job offer and a chance encounter with a mysterious stranger threaten to change everything, leading him to re-examine his life and his way of looking at it.

[From [url=https://kentaro-manedwuff.itch.io/buck-naked]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
浣熊克里夫走到哪里都能看到裸鹿。这……对他来说并不奇怪，而且这就是他喜欢的方式。但一份奇怪的工作机会和一次与神秘陌生人的偶遇可能会改变一切，让他重新审视自己的生活和看待生活的方式。

[来自[url=https://kentaro-manedwuff.itch.io/buck-naked]Itch.io[/url]]
